pages.text: Put an Essence of Entanglement between two unlinked qBlocks of the same type. All six faces must match, including Air and any stored container or machine data. Keep the other slots empty.
pages.title: Match the Ingredients

pages.text: The same grid also accepts two unlinked $(l:qcraft:computers/computer)Quantum Computers$(/l). You receive two items that share a frequency. Hover each to check its Frequency line.
pages.title: Pair Computers
